title: Key Performance Indicator
description: A Key Performance Indicator (KPI) is a type of performance measurement. KPIs evaluate the success of an organization or a particular activity in which it engages

type.description: Property. It must be KeyPerformanceIndicator. Enum:'KeyPerformanceIndicator'

category.description: Property. Indicator category. Allowed values: (quantitative, qualitative, leading, lagging, input, process, output, practical, directional, actionable, financial). Check Wikipedia for a description of each category listed above. - Any other value meaningful to the application and not covered by the above list

items.description: Property. Every possible value of the category. A minimum of one cateogry is mandatory

organization.description: Property. Subject organization evaluated by the KPI. Model:' https://schema.org/organization'

process.description: Property. Either process or product must be defined

product.description: Property. Either process or product must be defined

provider.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/provider'. Provider of the product or service, if any, that this KPI evaluates

businessTarget.description: Property. For informative purposes, the business target to which this KPI is related to

calculationFrequency.description: Property. How often the KPI is calculated. Allowed values: one Of (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, quarterly, bimonthly, biweekly). Or any other value meaningful for the application and not covered by the above list

calculatedBy.description: Property. The organization in charge of calculating the KPI

calculationFormula.description: Property. For informative purposes, the formula used for calculating the indicator

aggregatedData.description: Property.  Entity(ies) and attribute(s) aggregated by the KPI

items.description: Property. Object containing the entity type and the attributes of the KPI

entityType.description: Property. Entity type of the aggregated data

attrs.description: Property. List of subattributes of the KPI

items.description: Property. Every subattribute of the KPI

from.description: Property. Start of the calculation period

to.description: Property. End of the calculation period

currentStanding.description: Property. The KPI's current standing as per its kpiValue. Allowed values: one Of (very good, good, fair, bad, very bad)

kpiValue.description: Property. Value of the KPI. It can be of any type

effectiveSince.description: Property. The date on which the organization created this KPI. This date might be different than the entity creation date

dateNextCalculation.description: Property. Date on which a new calculation of the KPI should be available

dateExpires.description: Property. The date on which the KPI will be no longer necessary or meaningful

updatedAt.description: Property. Last update date of the KPI data. This can be different than the last update date of the KPI's value

area.description: Property. For organizational purposes, it allows to add extra textual geographical information such as district, borough, or any other hint which can help to identify the KPI coverage

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

EntityIdentifierType.description: Relationship. Unique identifier of the entity

dateCreated.description: Property. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform

dateModified.description: Property. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data as a URL. Recommended to be the fully qualified domain name of the source provider, or the URL to the source object

name.description: Property. The name of this item

alternateName.description: Property. An alternative name for this item

description.description: Property. A description of this item

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity

owner.description: Property. A List containing a JSON encoded sequence of characters referencing the unique Ids of the owner(s)

seeAlso.description: Property. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item

oneOf.title: GeoJSON Point
oneOf.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point

oneOf.title: GeoJSON LineString
oneOf.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. LineString

bbox.description: Property. BBox coordinates of the LineString

oneOf.title: GeoJSON Polygon
oneOf.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Polygon

bbox.description: Property. BBox coordinates of the Polygon

oneOf.title: GeoJSON MultiPoint
oneOf.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. MultiPoint

bbox.description: Property. BBox coordinates of the LineString

oneOf.title: GeoJSON MultiLineString
oneOf.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. MultiLineString

bbox.description: Property. BBox coordinates of the LineString

oneOf.title: GeoJSON MultiPolygon
oneOf.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. MultiLineString

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. It can be Point, LineString, Polygon, MultiPoint, MultiLineString or MultiPolygon

addressLocality.description: Property. The locality in which the street address is, and which is in the region. Model:'https://schema.org/addressLocality'

addressRegion.description: Property. The region in which the locality is, and which is in the country. Model:'https://schema.org/addressRegion'

addressCountry.description: Property. The country. For example, Spain. Model:'https://schema.org/addressCountry'

postalCode.description: Property. The postal code. For example, 24004. Model:'https://schema.org/https://schema.org/postalCode'

postOfficeBoxNumber.description: Property. The post office box number for PO box addresses. For example, 03578. Model:'https://schema.org/postOfficeBoxNumber'

streetNr.description: Property. Number identifying a specific property on a public street

district.description: Property. A district is a type of administrative division that, in some countries, is managed by the local government

areaServed.description: Property. The geographic area where a service or offered item is provided. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

x-origen.modificacion: Los $ref remotos a common-schema.json se sustituyen por sus definiciones locales (sin red); el resto es idéntico.
